name: Shelby Mustang GT350r 1000R
description: The Shelby GT350R is the track-focused variant of Ford's iconic sixth-generation Mustang, introduced in 2015 as the most race-ready production Mustang ever built. This tuned 1000R variant features a Whipple supercharger mounted to the legendary 5.2-liter Voodoo flat-plane crank V8, pushing output to over 1,000 whp with boost-by-gear tuning. The naturally aspirated base engine already stood apart with its exotic flat-plane crankshaft design enabling an 8,250 rpm redline, a first for any American production V8. The GT350R features extensive weight reduction including carbon fiber wheels, deletion of air conditioning and rear seats, and MagneRide adaptive suspension. Combined with aggressive aerodynamics including a large rear wing and front splitter, the GT350R delivers exceptional track performance while maintaining road legality.
author: Hell.Hound.Racing.Clan_HHRC
